name: Audit Strike
concept: Deal damage and gain block if the target has a debuff.
design_goal: Reward setup without requiring a complex rules exception.

name: Borrowed Lantern
concept: Reveal extra information about the first enemy action.
design_goal: Make planning feel stronger without increasing raw damage.

name: Delayed
concept: Trigger a small penalty at the end of the round.
design_goal: Create tension around timing and round structure.
